name: Charlotte
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Charlotte for 2026, and here is what he found: 24 family events, 11 of them free. The magic runs from November 21 (Snow Days at Discovery Place Science) through January 3, 2027 (WinterFest at Carowinds), with the Carolina Holiday Light Spectacular (November 27), The Nutcracker by Charlotte Youth Ballet (December 4) and The Polar Express Movie Screening at Romare Bearden Park (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Charlotte

  • 24 Christmas events for kids in Charlotte
  • 11 free events, including The Polar Express Movie Screening at Romare Bearden Park and Dig In Little Explorers at West Boulevard Library
  • Meet Santa: free photos in Santa's Castle at the Carolina Holiday Light Spectacular, Santa Brunch Weekend at DTR Plaza Midwood and Patty's Free Photos with Santa
  • Lights and snow: Carolina Holiday Light Spectacular, Light the Knights, WinterFest and Snow Days
  • Shows: The Nutcracker by Charlotte Youth Ballet, the Charlotte Ballet Nutcracker and the Holiday Pops family concert
  • Season: November 21, 2026 to January 3, 2027
